name: fi-transfer-pricing
description: Finland transfer-pricing documentation and arm's-length pricing for tax year 2026. Covers Finnish taxpayers with foreign related-party transactions and foreign enterprises with Finnish permanent establishments. Explains related control, the SME exemption, group-size aggregation, Master File and Local File contents, the EUR 500,000 counterparty simplification, Form 78, documentation requests and sanctions. Use for Finnish intercompany sales, services, financing, intangibles, restructuring, transfer-pricing adjustments, tax returns and evidence preparation. Distinguishes pricing, documentation and separate country-by-country reporting obligations. Includes ordinary transaction calculations and two recomputable examples. Specialist arrangements require a separately scoped transaction analysis; no professional attestation is claimed.
